notes.list_status: Certified. The page reads 'The following list contains all the Certified Candidates for the 2026 Municipal Election.'
notes.source_note: district_source_url is the Offices to be Elected page, which confirms the six council offices but lists no candidates; the 'Who is Running?' page was used.
notes.name_format_note: Surnames are printed in CAPS, so the surname boundary is usually unambiguous. One mayoral candidate, 'Andrea Wood', is published in mixed case; splitting falls back to the final token for that name.
notes.structure_match: Regional Councillor and City Councillor each have Ward 1-3 entries, matching both structure-CSV rows.
notes.position: From the office pages' headings, 'City Councillor, Ward 1' and 'Regional Councillor, Ward 1'. Pickering elects both from the same three wards, and the titles are what tell them apart.
notes.withdrawals: Two names carry a '- WITHDRAWN' suffix on the page and are excluded here: Zubahir MOHAMED as regional councillor for Ward 1, and Laurin JEFFREY as city councillor for Ward 1. Zubahir MOHAMED is listed without the suffix as a Ward 1 city councillor candidate, so he moved between the two offices rather than leaving the ballot.
